items.item: Owner chooses the agent-action owner: page-declared operations or UI SDK bridge
No persistent action row on a healthy artifact; host actions on hover, focus-within and touch; failures stay visible; aria-labels, no tooltips (static per state + interaction)
Presentation context and size through the existing bridge; one scroll owner; resize and theme change keep the App running (interaction + static)
@theorem/ui in the registry and library sources over Astryx in Theorem's Theme; annotate and spatial import from it; declarations reach TSRS (static per control + type check)
Code-mode search finds the kit docs and examples; no prompt text added (behaviour)
Gray-Scott recomposed on the kit in the picked direction; shader, palette, ranges and precision unchanged (static + interaction)
Kit controls in an Observable notebook through an explicit mount with cleanup and one React identity (static + interaction)
Read, change, pause and reset through the same functions as the visible controls; receipt reports the observed value (interaction)
A newly authored control checked by TSRS and built by esbuild-wasm, no new host enum or schema (static story)
Real e2e chat: varied questions and models; desktop/narrow, light/dark, keyboard/touch host actions, expand, reopen saved revision, unmount cleanup; owner opens the collages
